NSCameraUsageDescription: Yola uses the camera so you can photograph tickets, bookings and menus.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Yola uses your photos so you can upload ticket and booking screenshots.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Yola uses your location to show places open near you and to adjust your plan.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Yola uses the microphone to translate your conversations.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Yola turns your speech into text so it can be translated.
